API v8 (preview) – Introduced in Login Enterprise v6.0 and subject to breaking changes.

API v7 – is the recommended version to use. It is the actively developed version starting with Login Enterprise v6.0.

API v6 – is currently supported, but unmaintained as of v6.0.

API v5 and v4 - These versions are removed in v6.0.
The Login Enterprise Public API provides documentation and Swagger per version within the product. For additional information please refer to the [documentation](https://appliance.example.com on our website.

parameters.name: groupColumns
parameters.description:
A list of columns used for grouping the metrics. This parameter allows customization of how metrics are grouped in the results.
When specified, the grouping will always include '_measurement' (representing the metric ID) and 'environment_key'.
Available options for grouping include:
- '_measurement': The metric ID. (always included)
- 'environment_key': The key identifying the environment. (always included)
- 'instance': The specific instance or source associated with the metrics.
- 'group': The group or category of the metrics.
- 'component_type': The type of the components associated with the metrics.
- '{user_defined_custom_tag}': Any user-defined custom tags.

parameters.name: customTagsFilters
parameters.description:
Filters for custom tags. The expected format can be one of the following:
- "tagKey=tagValue1;tagValue2;tagValue3": Selects metrics where 'tagKey' is equal to 'tagValue1', 'tagValue2' OR 'tagValue3'.
- "tagKey=*": Selects metrics where 'tagKey' is present in the collection of custom tags.

tags.name: User
tags.description:
The User API provides endpoints for managing and retrieving users. It allows you to create, update, and delete users,
as well as retrieve a paginated list of all users or get specific user details by ID.

tags.name: WebAutomationDrivers
tags.description:
The WebAutomationDrivers API provides endpoints to effectively manage web automation drivers for the target engine running web-based workloads
on the target/user sessions. It allows you to retrieve the list of current and missing drivers, download the latest drivers, update the configuration
for driver updates, and retrieve the current driver update configuration settings. This API ensures your web automation environment remains efficient
and up-to-date with the necessary drivers.

tags.name: UserSession
tags.description:
The User Sessions API provides endpoints to manage and retrieve details about user sessions within specific test runs.
It allows you to query and retrieve user session data based on unique identifiers, with options to include additional details and properties.
The API facilitates monitoring and managing user session states, metrics, and associated test and account information.

tags.name: UserSessionMetrics
tags.description:
The UserSessionMetrics API provides endpoints for retrieving and managing metrics related to user sessions. These endpoints allow you
to access detailed performance and usage data for user sessions, filtered and sorted by various criteria. The API supports querying metrics
within specific date-time ranges, sorting by attributes such as timestamp or display name, and includes options for pagination and detailed metric
information. This enables comprehensive monitoring and analysis of user session performance and behavior.

tags.name: UserSessionMetricDefinition
tags.description:
The UserSessionMetricDefinition API provides endpoints to manage and retrieve user session metric definitions.
These definitions enable you to monitor and analyze performance metrics related to user sessions within your application.

tags.name: SessionMetricDefinitionGroups
tags.description:
The SessionMetricDefinitionGroups API provides endpoints for managing user session metric groups within the system.
It allows you to create, retrieve, update, and delete session metric groups, as well as manage tests associated with these groups.
The API supports operations such as fetching detailed information about session metric groups, adding or removing tests linked to groups,
and listing groups in a paginated manner.

tags.name: SessionMetricDefinitionGroupMembers
tags.description:
The SessionMetricDefinitionGroupMembers API provides endpoints for managing user session metric groups, facilitating operations to
retrieve, add, replace, and remove members within these groups.

tags.name: ApplicationTestThreshold
tags.description:
The ApplicationTestThreshold API provides endpoints to manage thresholds for applications and tests. It allows you to create, retrieve, update,
and delete thresholds, enabling effective configuration and monitoring of application parameters.

tags.name: ConnectionResources
tags.description:
The Connection Resources API provides endpoints for managing connection resources linked to tests.
It includes functionalities for retrieving and updating connection settings such as connectors, launcher groups,
and account groups associated with a specific test.

tags.name: ContinuousTestNotification
tags.description:
The ContinuousTestNotification API provides endpoints to manage and configure notifications within the system. It includes operations for creating,
retrieving, updating, and deleting notifications associated with Tests or Applications. Utilize these endpoints to integrate notification
functionalities into your applications, ensuring timely alerts and updates based on predefined thresholds and conditions.

tags.name: ReportConfiguration
tags.description:
The ReportConfiguration API provides endpoints to manage report configurations, including creating, updating, deleting,
and retrieving configurations and associated assets.

tags.name: TestAccess
tags.description:
The TestAccess API provides endpoints for retrieving, updating, and managing the access control lists (ACLs) of Tests and roles associated
with those Tests. This helps you enable fine-grained access control based on user roles and permissions.

tags.name: Test
tags.description:
The Test API provides endpoints to manage and retrieve different types of tests, for example, Application Tests, Load Tests,
and Continuous Tests. It allows you to create, retrieve, update, and delete Tests, as well as retrieve lists of Tests based on
various criteria, such as Test type, Launcher group, Account group, Application group, Environment ID, and Session Metric Definition
Group ID. You can also start and stop the Test, enable and disable Tests in bulk, and retrieve and update active time slots for scheduling Tests.

tags.name: Workload
tags.description:
The Workload API enables control and management of test workloads. This API provides endpoints to retrieve, add, update, and delete
workload steps associated with specific tests. It allows you to configure, modify, and maintain the workload details for different testing scenarios.

tags.name: TestRunAccess
tags.description:
The TestRun API access provides endpoints to manage and retrieve information about Test run access.It includes operations for creating, updating,
retrieving, and deleting Test run access data.

tags.name: TestRun
tags.description:
The TestRun API provides endpoints to manage and retrieve information about Test runs. It includes operations for creating, updating,
retrieving, and deleting Test run data, as well as querying results, such as EUX score and VSImax and performance metrics.

tags.name: System
tags.description: The System API provides endpoints to retrieve information about the current and latest versions of the system as well as the EUX version of the system.

tags.name: Statistic
tags.description:
The Statistic API provides endpoints to retrieve diagnostics information for Continuous Tests as well as diagnostics information for Continuous Tests
and applications based on a specific test ID. This API helps in obtaining detailed diagnostic data to analyze and troubleshoot test results.

tags.name: Screenshot
tags.description:
The Screenshot API provides endpoints to retrieve screenshots related to specific application executions. You can obtain individual screenshots by
their event ID, app execution ID, or screenshot ID, as well as a list of all screenshots associated with a particular app execution ID.
This API enables detailed visual analysis of application states at various execution points.

tags.name: Report
tags.description:
The Report API provides endpoints for retrieving and downloading reports. It includes operations to get paginated lists of Continuous Test reports,
fetch Application Test reports by Test run ID, download PDF files of reports by ID, download both Load and Application Test report PDF files by a list of Test run IDs.

tags.name: LdapGroup
tags.description:
The LdapGroup API provides endpoints to manage LDAP groups, including operations to create, retrieve, update, and delete groups.
It supports pagination for retrieving lists of groups and allows for the management of group details by ID.

tags.name: Permission
tags.description:
The Permissions API provides endpoints for managing and retrieving permissions. It allows you to list all available permissions
and retrieve the specific permissions assigned to the authenticated user based on their roles or individual access rights.

tags.name: Role
tags.description:
The Role API provides endpoints for managing and retrieving roles. It allows you to create, update, and delete roles, as well as retrieve a
paginated list of all roles or get specific role details by ID. Additionally, it enables retrieving the roles assigned to the authenticated user.

tags.name: RawDataReport
tags.description:
Provides endpoints to create and retrieve raw data report exports.
POST creates a new export request. GET by id returns 409 while processing and streams the file when finished.
Requires TestsResultsRead authorization.

tags.name: Provider
tags.description: The Provider API provides endpoints for managing providers, including creating, updating, retrieving, testing connections, and deleting provider entries.

tags.name: PlatformMetrics
tags.description:
The PlatformMetrics API provides endpoints for handling operations related to Platform Metrics for specified environments. It allows you to
add a collection of platform metrics for a specified environment and retrieve a collection of Platform Metrics based on the specified filters.

tags.name: Measurement
tags.description:
The Measurement API provides endpoints for retrieving paginated lists of measurements associated with a
specified Test run ID, Application execution ID, and Session ID.

tags.name: Location
tags.description: The Location API provides endpoints for managing locations, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting location entries.

tags.name: LauncherAccess
tags.description:
The launcher Access API provides endpoints for managing launcher-role access control.
It includes the following functionalities: retrieving assigned and unassigned roles for launchers,
updating access for a single launcher, and performing bulk add, remove, or replace operations for multiple launchers.

tags.name: Launcher
tags.description:
The Launcher API provides endpoints for managing Launchers, including retrieving a single Launcher or multiple
Launcher entries and changing the Launcher’s location.

tags.name: LauncherRestartSchedule
tags.description: The Launcher Restart Schedule API provides endpoints for managing scheduled launcher/machine restarts.

tags.name: LauncherUpdateSchedule
tags.description: The Launcher Update Schedule API provides endpoints for configuring launcher auto-updates and scheduled update checks.

tags.name: LauncherGroupAccess
tags.description:
The launcher group Access API provides endpoints for managing launcher-group-role access control.
It includes the following functionalities: retrieving assigned and unassigned roles for launcher groups,
updating access for a single launcher group, and performing bulk add, remove, or replace operations for multiple launcher groups.

tags.name: LauncherGroup
tags.description:
The Launcher Group API provides endpoints for managing Launcher Groups, including creating, updating, retrieving,
and deleting single and multiple Location Group entries.

tags.name: LauncherGroupMember
tags.description:
The LauncherGroupMember API provides endpoints for managing Launcher Group members. This includes retrieving details about existing members,
as well as adding or removing members from the Launcher Group.

tags.name: GlobalSettings
tags.description: Controller for managing global settings in IdentityServer.

tags.name: LdapConfiguration
tags.description: The LdapConfiguration API provides endpoints for retrieving details about the LDAP configuration, and creating, updating, and removing the LDAP configuration.

tags.name: SamlConfiguration
tags.description: Controller for managing SAML configuration in IdentityServer.

tags.name: WebProviders
tags.description:
Controller for managing IdentityServer web authentication providers.
Supports listing providers, retrieving by provider type, and updating provider configuration.

tags.name: Event
tags.description:
The Event API provides endpoints for retrieving details about events. This includes retrieving paginated lists of all events and
paginated lists of events with specified Test run ID, Application execution ID, User session ID, and Event ID.

tags.name: EuxSettings
tags.description: The EuxSettings API provides endpoints for managing EUX settings. This includes retrieving details about the EUX settings and updating the EUX settings.

tags.name: Environment
tags.description:
The Environment API provides endpoints for managing Environments. It includes the following functionalities: creating, updating, retrieving,
and deleting Environment entries, retrieving details about the cost history for a specific Environment, retrieving Tests associated with
an Environment by its ID, and adding or removing Tests from an Environment.

tags.name: ConnectorScript
tags.description:
The Connector Script API provides endpoints for managing connector scripts.
It includes operations for retrieving, creating, and deleting custom connector scripts,
as well as retrieving default connector scripts.

tags.name: ConnectorPackage
tags.description:
The Connector Package API provides endpoints for managing connector packages.
It includes operations for listing, retrieving, downloading, creating, updating, and deleting
connector packages. The package archive is a ZIP file uploaded and downloaded as binary content.

tags.name: ApplicationAccess
tags.description:
The Application Access API provides endpoints for managing application-role access control.
It includes the following functionalities: retrieving assigned and unassigned roles for applications,
updating access for a single application, and performing bulk add, remove, or replace operations for multiple applications.

tags.name: Application
tags.description:
The Application API provides endpoints for managing Applications. It includes the following functionalities: creating, updating, retrieving,
and deleting Application entries as well as extracting Application details from script content and returning them in a structured format.

tags.name: ApplicationGroupAccess
tags.description:
The Application Group Access API provides endpoints for managing access control of application groups.
It includes the following functionalities: retrieving role assignments for application groups,
updating access for a single group, and performing bulk add, remove, or replace operations across multiple groups.

tags.name: ApplicationGroup
tags.description:
The ApplicationGroup API provides endpoints for managing Application groups. It includes the following functionalities: creating, updating,
retrieving, and deleting Application group entries as well as adding, removing, updating, and replacing steps in an Application group.

tags.name: Script
tags.description:
The Script API provides endpoints for creating and retrieving scripts associated with specific Applications.
It enables you to create new scripts via text or file uploads and retrieve the content of existing scripts using an Application ID.

tags.name: ApplianceHealth
tags.description:
The ApplianceHealth API provides endpoints for handling operations related to Appliance Health. It allows you to retrieve a collection of
appliance health metrics based on the specified filters.

tags.name: AppExecution
tags.description:
The AppExecution API provides access to a paginated list of app execution records. This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information
about Application executions, including their status, timestamps, and duration.

tags.name: AccountAccess
tags.description:
The AccountAccess API provides endpoints for managing role-based access control for accounts.
It supports retrieving assigned and unassigned roles, updating access for a single account,
and performing bulk add, remove, and replace operations for multiple accounts.

tags.name: Account
tags.description:
The Account API provides endpoints for managing Accounts. It includes the following functionalities: creating, updating, retrieving,
and deleting Account entries as well as enabling and disabling single or multiple Accounts.

tags.name: AccountGroupAccess
tags.description:
The account group Access API provides endpoints for managing account-group-role access control.
It includes the following functionalities: retrieving assigned and unassigned roles for account groups,
updating access for a single account group, and performing bulk add, remove, or replace operations for multiple account groups.

tags.name: AccountGroups
tags.description:
The AccountGroups API provides endpoints for managing Account Groups. It includes the following functionalities: creating, updating, retrieving, and
deleting Account Group entries as well as retrieving details about Account Group candidates and enabling and disabling Accounts in Account Groups.

tags.name: AccountGroupMembers
tags.description:
The AccountGroupMembers API provides endpoints for managing Account Group members. It allows you to retrieve a paginated list of Account Group members,
add members to an Account Group, replace members in an Account Group, and remove members from an Account Group.
